name: Ask Mode
description: Mode that refuses Edit and Write at dispatch time. The model gives each change as a diff.

modes.label: ASK
modes.refusalHint: Do not use Edit or Write in this mode. The user applies changes. Give the change as a diff in the `diff -u` format, in a code block, or use the DiffViewerShowDiff tool. Do not make the change with Bash or another tool. The refusal is final. If the user wants the change applied, tell the user to leave the ask mode.
